verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no conversion matrix, formats list, or pair-lookup documentation showing which input formats convert to which outputs. The only format mentions are scattered across individual tasks (thumbnail outputs, archive types, optimize targets). Those describe adjacent features, not a documented input-to-output conversion map, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it
